Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. M.S. Pal, Senior Advocate assisted by Ms. 
Medha Pande, Advocate for the petitioner.
 Mr. Narain Dutt, Standing Counsel for the 
State.
 Heard.
 Admit.
 Learned Chief Standing Counsel takes notices 
on behalf of respondent nos.1 to 5.
 Issue notice to the respondent no.6, 
returnable within six weeks. Steps to be taken 
within a week. 
 Counter affidavit may be filed within four 
weeks.
 Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder affidavit, if 
any, may be filed.
 List thereafter. 
 Heard on Stay Application (IA) No.1 of 2025.
 It is the case of the petitioner that the services 
of the petitioner has been terminated by order 
dated 03.07.2025 on the ground that she did not 
possess the minimum required qualification. 
 Having considered, this Court is of the view 
that there is no reason to pass any interim order. 
Accordingly, the stay application deserves to be 
rejected. 
 Stay application is rejected accordingly. 
 
 
(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 23.07.2025
Sanjay
